section_title: Introduction to Trigonometry and its Ratios
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-10.7s) - Introduction
title = Text("Introduction to Trigonometry", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("The study of triangles", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN)
triangle = Polygon([-2,-1,0], [2,-1,0], [0,2,0], color=BLUE)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), Create(triangle), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 2 (10.7-17.3s) - Right triangles
right_triangle = Polygon([-2,-1,0], [1,-1,0], [-2,1,0], color=YELLOW)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).move_to([-2,-1,0]).shift(RIGHT*0.15 + UP*0.15)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(triangle, right_triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(4.6)

# Segment 3 (17.3-31.0s) - Highlighting acute angle
angle = Arc(
    radius=0.5,
    start_angle=0,
    angle=PI/3,
    color=RED
).move_to([-2,-1,0])
angle_label = MathTex(r"\theta", color=RED).next_to(angle, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
self.play(
    Create(angle),
    Write(angle_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Indicate(right_triangle, color=YELLOW, scale_factor=1.1),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(9.7)

# Segment 4 (31.0-52.3s) - Labeling sides
hyp_line = Line([-2,-1,0], [-2,1,0], color=GREEN)
opp_line = Line([-2,1,0], [1,-1,0], color=BLUE)
adj_line = Line([-2,-1,0], [1,-1,0], color=RED)

hyp_label = Text("Hypotenuse", color=GREEN, font_size=24).next_to(hyp_line, LEFT)
opp_label = Text("Opposite", color=BLUE, font_size=24).next_to(opp_line, RIGHT)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", color=RED, font_size=24).next_to(adj_line, DOWN)

self.play(
    Transform(right_triangle.copy(), hyp_line),
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Transform(right_triangle.copy(), opp_line),
    Write(opp_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Transform(right_triangle.copy(), adj_line),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(15.3)

# Segment 5 (52.3-63.5s) - Trig ratios list
ratios = VGroup(
    Text("sine (sin)", font_size=30),
    Text("cosine (cos)", font_size=30),
    Text("tangent (tan)", font_size=30),
    Text("cosecant (csc)", font_size=30),
    Text("secant (sec)", font_size=30),
    Text("cotangent (cot)", font_size=30)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    *[Write(ratio) for ratio in ratios],
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 6 (63.5-76.2s) - Ratio definitions table
definitions = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}"),
    MathTex(r"\cos \theta = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}"),
    MathTex(r"\tan \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(ratios, LEFT)

self.play(
    *[Write(definition) for definition in definitions],
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 1 (0.0-9.7s) - Introduction to reciprocal identities
title = Text("Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Understanding the relationships between trig ratios", 
                font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2.7)
self.wait(4)

# Segment 2 (9.7-17.8s) - Importance of reciprocal identities
formula_box = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\csc \theta = \frac{1}{\sin \theta}"),
    MathTex(r"\sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta}"),
    MathTex(r"\cot \theta = \frac{1}{\tan \theta}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    Write(formula_box),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(4.1)

# Segment 3 (17.8-31.5s) - Cosecant as reciprocal of sine
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-PI/2, PI/2],
    y_range=[-3, 3],
    axis_config={"include_numbers": True}
).scale(0.7).shift(DOWN)

sin_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: np.sin(x), color=BLUE)
csc_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/np.sin(x) if abs(np.sin(x)) > 0.1 else None, 
                     color=RED, discontinuities=[-PI/2, 0, PI/2])

sin_label = MathTex(r"\sin \theta", color=BLUE).next_to(sin_curve, UP)
csc_label = MathTex(r"\csc \theta", color=RED).next_to(csc_curve, UP)

self.play(
    FadeOut(formula_box),
    Create(axes),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(sin_curve), Write(sin_label), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(csc_curve), Write(csc_label), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 4 (31.5-40.1s) - Visualizing sine and cosecant relationship
relationship = MathTex(r"\csc \theta \cdot \sin \theta = 1").next_to(axes, UP)
highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(relationship, color=YELLOW)

self.play(Write(relationship), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(highlight_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.6)

# Segment 5 (40.1-49.2s) - Secant and cotangent reciprocals
other_relationships = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sec \theta \cdot \cos \theta = 1"),
    MathTex(r"\cot \theta \cdot \tan \theta = 1")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(relationship, UP)

self.play(
    FadeOut(highlight_box),
    Write(other_relationships),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(5.1)

# Segment 6 (49.2-62.5s) - Utility of reciprocal identities
example_box = VGroup(
    Text("Applications:", font_size=32),
    MathTex(r"\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \tan \theta"),
    MathTex(r"\frac{1}{\csc \theta} = \sin \theta")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(other_relationships),
    FadeOut(relationship),
    Write(example_box),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(9.2)

# Segment 7 (62.5-70.1s) - Impact of inversions in calculations
final_text = Text("Simplify Complex Expressions", font_size=36).to_edge(DOWN)
final_box = SurroundingRectangle(final_text, color=GREEN)

self.play(
    Write(final_text),
    Create(final_box),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(4.6)

section_title: Calculating All Ratios from a Given Tangent
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-17.3s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding All Trig Ratios from Tangent", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
given = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}").scale(1.2)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(given), run_time=2)
self.wait(13.3)

# Segment 2 (17.3-43.2s) - Drawing triangle and labeling
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*4,
    color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).next_to(ORIGIN, UR, buff=0)
angle_A = Arc(radius=0.5, angle=np.arctan(4/3), color=YELLOW)
angle_label = MathTex("A").next_to(angle_A, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
opp_label = MathTex("4").next_to(triangle, RIGHT)
adj_label = MathTex("3").next_to(triangle, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(given),
    Create(triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Create(angle_A),
    Write(angle_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(opp_label),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(18.9)

# Segment 3 (43.2-66.0s) - Pythagorean theorem
pyth = MathTex(r"c^2 = a^2 + b^2").to_edge(RIGHT)
pyth_calc = MathTex(r"c^2 = 4^2 + 3^2").next_to(pyth, DOWN)
self.play(Write(pyth), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(pyth_calc), run_time=2)
self.wait(18.9)

# Segment 4 (66.0-83.3s) - Calculate hypotenuse
hyp_calc = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"c^2 = 16 + 9 = 25"),
    MathTex(r"c = 5")
).arrange(DOWN).next_to(pyth_calc, DOWN)
hyp_label = MathTex("5").next_to(triangle.get_center(), UL)
self.play(Write(hyp_calc), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(hyp_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.3)

# Segment 5 (83.3-100.0s) - Calculate sine
sine_calc = MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{4}{5}")
sine_calc.to_edge(LEFT).shift(DOWN)
self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(pyth, pyth_calc, hyp_calc)),
    Write(sine_calc),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(13.8)

# Segment 6 (100.0-116.8s) - Calculate cosine, cosecant, secant
other_ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = \frac{3}{5}"),
    MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}"),
    MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}")
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).next_to(sine_calc, DOWN)
self.play(Write(other_ratios), run_time=4)
self.wait(12.8)

# Segment 7 (116.8-136.6s) - Calculate cotangent and conclude
cot_calc = MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}").next_to(other_ratios, DOWN)
final_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(sine_calc, other_ratios, cot_calc))
self.play(Write(cot_calc), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(final_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(15.8)

section_title: Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-17.8s) - Introduction
title = Text("Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
given = MathTex(r"\sin B = \sin Q").next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.8)
condition = Text("where B and Q are acute angles", font_size=32).next_to(given, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(given), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(condition), run_time=2.8)
self.wait(10)

# Segment 2 (17.8-28.9s) - State goal
goal = Text("Goal: Prove that B = Q", font_size=36).next_to(condition, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(goal), run_time=2.2)
self.wait(9)

# Segment 3 (28.9-39.6s) - Draw triangles
triangle_abc = Polygon([-3, -1, 0], [-3, 1, 0], [-1, -1, 0])
triangle_pqr = Polygon([1, -1, 0], [1, 1, 0], [3, -1, 0])
right_angle_c = Square(side_length=0.2).move_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[2]).rotate(PI/4)
right_angle_r = Square(side_length=0.2).move_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[2]).rotate(PI/4)

labels_abc = VGroup(
    MathTex("A").next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[1], UP),
    MathTex("B").next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[0], LEFT),
    MathTex("C").next_to(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[2], DOWN)
)
labels_pqr = VGroup(
    MathTex("P").next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[1], UP),
    MathTex("Q").next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[0], LEFT),
    MathTex("R").next_to(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[2], DOWN)
)

self.play(
    Create(triangle_abc),
    Create(triangle_pqr),
    Create(right_angle_c),
    Create(right_angle_r),
    run_time=5
)
self.play(Write(labels_abc), Write(labels_pqr), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.7)

# Segment 4 (39.6-51.8s) - Show sine B ratio
sine_b = MathTex(r"\sin B = \frac{AC}{AB}").next_to(triangle_abc, DOWN, buff=1)
self.play(Write(sine_b), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Indicate(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[1], color=YELLOW),  # A
    Indicate(triangle_abc.get_vertices()[0], color=YELLOW),  # B
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.2)

# Segment 5 (51.8-69.5s) - Show sine Q ratio and equality
sine_q = MathTex(r"\sin Q = \frac{PR}{PQ}").next_to(sine_b, RIGHT, buff=1)
equality = MathTex(r"\frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{PR}{PQ}").next_to(sine_b, DOWN, buff=1)
self.play(Write(sine_q), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Indicate(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[1], color=YELLOW),  # P
    Indicate(triangle_pqr.get_vertices()[0], color=YELLOW),  # Q
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(equality), run_time=3)
self.wait(9.8)

# Segment 6 (69.5-89.3s) - Introduce k ratio
k_ratio = MathTex(r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ} = k").next_to(equality, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(k_ratio), run_time=4)
self.wait(15.8)

# Segment 7 (89.3-100.5s) - Express sides with k
k_sides = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"AC = k \cdot PR"),
    MathTex(r"AB = k \cdot PQ")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(k_ratio, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(k_sides), run_time=4)
self.wait(7.2)

# Segments 8-9 (100.5-140.1s) - Pythagorean theorem
pyth_abc = MathTex(r"BC^2 = (k \cdot PQ)^2 - (k \cdot PR)^2").next_to(k_sides, DOWN, buff=0.8)
pyth_pqr = MathTex(r"QR^2 = PQ^2 - PR^2").next_to(pyth_abc, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(pyth_abc), run_time=5)
self.wait(15.3)
self.play(Write(pyth_pqr), run_time=5)
self.wait(14.3)

# Segment 10 (140.1-157.9s) - BC and QR relationship
bc_qr = MathTex(r"BC = k \cdot QR").next_to(pyth_pqr, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(bc_qr), run_time=4)
self.wait(13.8)

# Segment 11 (157.9-174.1s) - Similar triangles
similar = Text("Triangles ABC and PQR are similar", font_size=36).next_to(bc_qr, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(similar), run_time=4)
self.wait(12.2)

# Segment 12 (174.1-184.3s) - Conclude angle equality
conclusion = MathTex(r"\therefore B = Q").next_to(similar, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(conclusion), run_time=3)
self.wait(7.2)

# Segment 13 (184.3-195.0s) - Summary
summary = Text("Proof complete using trigonometry and similar triangles", font_size=32).next_to(conclusion, DOWN, buff=0.8)
self.play(Write(summary), run_time=3)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 1 (0-13.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("Trigonometric Ratios & Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Examples and Applications", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(9.2)

# Segment 2 (13.2-27.4s) - First example setup
example1 = Text("Example 1:", font_size=36).to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP)
given = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}").next_to(example1, RIGHT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    title.animate.scale(0.8).to_corner(UP + LEFT),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(example1), Write(given), run_time=3)
self.wait(9.2)

# Segment 3 (27.4-39.1s) - Right triangle visualization
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT * 3, UP * 4 + RIGHT * 3, color=WHITE
).scale(0.8).shift(DOWN + LEFT * 2)
labels = VGroup(
    MathTex("3").next_to(triangle, DOWN),
    MathTex("4").next_to(triangle, RIGHT),
    MathTex("A").next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], DOWN + LEFT * 0.3)
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3, color=WHITE).next_to(
    triangle.get_vertices()[0], UP + RIGHT, buff=0
)

self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Create(right_angle),
    Write(labels),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 4 (39.1-53.3s) - Calculating hypotenuse and ratios
hyp_calc = MathTex(
    r"h^2 = 3^2 + 4^2 = 25",
    r"\therefore h = 5"
).arrange(DOWN).next_to(triangle, RIGHT * 3)
ratios = MathTex(
    r"\sin A = \frac{4}{5}",
    r"\cos A = \frac{3}{5}",
    r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}",
    r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}",
    r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}"
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).next_to(hyp_calc, DOWN)

self.play(Write(hyp_calc), run_time=4)
self.play(Write(ratios), run_time=4)
self.wait(6.2)

# Segment 5 (53.3-78.2s) - Second example introduction
self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(triangle, labels, right_angle, hyp_calc, ratios, example1, given)),
    run_time=2
)

example2 = Text("Example 2:", font_size=36).to_edge(LEFT).shift(UP)
given2 = MathTex(r"\sin B = \sin Q").next_to(example2, RIGHT)
condition = Text("(B and Q are acute angles)", font_size=24).next_to(given2, DOWN)

self.play(Write(example2), Write(given2), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(condition), run_time=2)
self.wait(17.9)

# Segment 6 (78.2-97.0s) - Setting up sine ratios
triangle1 = Polygon(ORIGIN, RIGHT * 2, UP * 1.5 + RIGHT * 2, color=BLUE)
triangle2 = Polygon(ORIGIN, RIGHT * 2.5, UP * 1.875 + RIGHT * 2.5, color=RED)
triangle2.shift(RIGHT * 3)

labels1 = VGroup(
    MathTex("B", color=BLUE).next_to(triangle1.get_vertices()[0], DOWN + LEFT),
    MathTex("a", color=BLUE).next_to(triangle1, RIGHT),
    MathTex("h_1", color=BLUE).next_to(triangle1, UP)
)

labels2 = VGroup(
    MathTex("Q", color=RED).next_to(triangle2.get_vertices()[0], DOWN + LEFT),
    MathTex("b", color=RED).next_to(triangle2, RIGHT),
    MathTex("h_2", color=RED).next_to(triangle2, UP)
)

self.play(
    Create(triangle1),
    Create(triangle2),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Write(labels1),
    Write(labels2),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(12.8)

# Segment 7 (97.0-115.8s) - Proving similarity
ratio_eq = MathTex(
    r"\frac{h_1}{a} = \frac{h_2}{b}"
).next_to(VGroup(triangle1, triangle2), DOWN * 2)

similar_text = Text(
    "Similar triangles ⟹ B = Q",
    font_size=32
).next_to(ratio_eq, DOWN)

self.play(Write(ratio_eq), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(similar_text), run_time=3)
self.wait(12.8)

# Segment 8 (115.8-126.4s) - Summary
summary = Text(
    "Using trigonometric ratios and algebra\nto solve problems and verify relationships",
    font_size=32,
    line_spacing=1.5
).move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(
        triangle1, triangle2, labels1, labels2,
        ratio_eq, similar_text, example2, given2, condition
    )),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(summary), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.7)
